lines.beaver: 어서 와요. 오늘 김치 담그는 법 알려 줄게요.
lines.beaver_en: Come in. Today I'll show you how to make kimchi.
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo wayo. oneul gimchi damgeuneun beop allyeo julgeyo.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 우리 엄마가 김치 담그기가 어렵대요.
lines.en: Thank you. My mom says making kimchi is hard.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. uri eommaga gimchi damgeugiga eoryeopdaeyo.

lines.beaver: 하나도 안 어려워요. 재료는 뭐가 필요할까요?
lines.beaver_en: It's not hard at all. What ingredients do we need?
lines.beaver_roman: hanado an eoryeowoyo. jaeryoneun mwoga piryohalkkayo?
lines.en: I heard we need cabbage, onions, and carrots. Right?

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 배추는 싱싱한 걸 사야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. You have to buy fresh cabbage.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. baechuneun singsinghan geol saya haeyo.
lines.en: They say the cabbage at the market vegetable shop is fresh.

lines.beaver_en: Good. First, soak the cabbage in salt water.
lines.en: How long do I soak it? My friend says overnight is good.

lines.beaver: 네, 하룻밤이면 돼요. 그다음엔 양념을 만들어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, overnight is fine. Next, we make the seasoning paste.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, harutbamimyeon dwaeyo. geudaeumen yangnyeomeul mandeureoyo.
lines.en: They say it tastes good with a little honey in the seasoning.

lines.beaver: 꿀은 조금만 넣어요. 조미료는 많이 넣지 마세요.
lines.beaver_en: Add just a little honey. Don't add too much seasoning.
lines.beaver_roman: kkureun jogeumman neoeoyo. jomiryoneun mani neochi maseyo.
lines.en: Got it. Do I stir the paste well with a spoon?

lines.beaver: 네, 잘 저어서 배추에 골고루 발라요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, stir it well and spread it evenly on the cabbage.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jal jeoeoseo baechue golgoru ballayo.
lines.learner: 국물은 위에 부어요? 요리법이 참 쉽네요.
lines.en: Do I pour the liquid on top? The recipe is really easy.
lines.roman: gungmureun wie bueoyo? yoribeobi cham swimneyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 조금 부어요. 다른 요리도 배우고 싶어요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, pour a little. Do you want to learn other dishes too?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jogeum bueoyo. dareun yorido baeugo sipeoyo?
lines.learner: 쇠고기 버섯 볶음이 쉽대요. 그것도 배우고 싶어요.
lines.en: I heard stir-fried beef with mushrooms is easy. I want to learn it too.
lines.roman: soegogi beoseot bokkeumi swipdaeyo. geugeotdo baeugo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 다음 주에 같이 만들어서 먹어요.
lines.beaver_en: Sure. Let's make it and eat together next week.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. daeum jue gachi mandeureoseo meogeoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 제가 상을 차릴게요. 고구마도 가져올게요.
lines.en: Then I'll set the table. I'll bring sweet potatoes too.
lines.roman: geureom jega sangeul charilgeyo. gogumado gajyeoolgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Be sure to taste the kimchi once it ripens.
lines.en: Yes, thank you! My husband says he's already hungry.
